summary: First iteration. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests pass (auth register/login/lockout/me/logout/forgot/reset, profile get/patch, posts create/list/filter/like, error paths). Frontend: landing layout, tagline, all 3 CTA buttons and 4 quadrants render; sign-in (admin), sign-up (new user), guest browse all redirect correctly; mode-switcher in app shell instantly retheme all 4 modes; feed composer posts a thought that appears at top; feed filter bar with 6 chips works; navigation, settings, profile widgets, header upload (+) for guest and authenticated work; session persists across reload; mode persists via localStorage. One CRITICAL pointer-events bug found: the landing center panel wrapper covers the full viewport and intercepts clicks meant for the 4 quadrant buttons, so 'Click any quadrant to switch mode' interaction is broken from the UI (works via JS click only).

ui_bugs.issue: Wrapper div 'relative z-10 min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center px-4' covers the entire viewport and intercepts pointer events, so clicking any of the 4 quadrants (landing-quadrant-cypher/business/millennium/stealth) has no effect — document.elementFromPoint anywhere on screen returns this wrapper. setMode/onClick handlers never fire from mouse clicks. Theming itself works (verified via programmatic .click() — html[data-mode] updates and visuals change). Fix: add pointer-events-none to the wrapper and pointer-events-auto to the inner OurRealm panel card.

action_items: Fix Landing.jsx pointer-events: wrap the center OurRealm card in a container with pointer-events-none and set pointer-events-auto only on the inner card so quadrant buttons (landing-quadrant-*) are clickable from the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT cookie 'secure=False' is acceptable for preview but should be True in production deploy (set behind HTTPS).
set_auth_cookies samesite='lax' may not be sent on cross-origin requests; frontend correctly uses Bearer fallback via localStorage 'ourrealm.access'.
Brute-force lockout key is ip:email — behind a CDN/proxy req.client.host may be the proxy IP, locking out many users; consider using X-Forwarded-For or email-only.
Posts list endpoint sorts by created_at stored as ISO string — works in lexicographic order but mixing string and datetime types in the same field is fragile.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed users and posts via API. Not cleaned up but use unique uuids to avoid collisions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_ourrealm_api.py (20 tests, all green) — re-run with: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v`. The lockout test uses a unique fresh email per run to avoid contaminating admin. For frontend, the landing pointer-events bug is the only blocker; everything else (sign-in admin@ourrealm.app/admin123, sign-up flow, guest browse + guest-prompt modal, mode-switcher in header, feed composer + filter chips, nav-* sidebar, profile widgets, settings, persistence on reload) verified working. App shell mode-switcher uses data-testid mode-switcher-{cypher|business|millennium|stealth}. Notifications nav uses data-testid='nav-notifications' but the visible label is 'Alerts'. nav-logout testid is present in side-nav. header-profile-button testid present (was momentarily not loaded in one race). Re-run frontend with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://realm-deploy.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca_of_the_landing_quadrant_bug: Landing.jsx renders the 4-quadrant grid (absolute inset-0) and then a sibling div for the center card with classes 'relative z-10 min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center px-4'. That sibling has no background but full screen dimensions and pointer-events:auto by default, so it covers the quadrant <button>s entirely. elementFromPoint(x,y) anywhere returns this wrapper, never the quadrant. Programmatic .click() on the quadrant testid still fires the onClick handler and proves setMode works (data-mode updates and theme tokens change). Fix: add `pointer-events-none` to the wrapper and `pointer-events-auto` on the inner OurRealm panel card.
